messages.subject: S2 review: PASS
messages.body: Reviewed S2 at head 5afaf7c582d26d4836946dae8c27970fce9a2d42 against AC-1/4/5/6; all four are met and guarded by tests, and the suite passes (60 tests OK). Two MEDIUM edge-case findings, both unguarded and confirmed by probe: markers inside a code fence get rewritten (toc.py:90), and duplicated or stray markers leave the second pair stale (toc.py:102), so --check misses it. Several LOW notes remain (--stdout prints TOC only, --check plus --stdout, mixed line endings); none block the verdict.
